shortDescription: Returns job information according to inputs.

options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: joblog
options.description: The job log of the job executing the task will be returned even rc is zero if it is set to true.

options.name: name
options.description: The qualified job name. If this parameter is specified, the other parameters will be ignored.

options.name: submitter
options.description: The type of submitted jobs to return.

options.name: subsystem
options.description: The job subsystem filter. A valid subsystem name can be specified. Valid values are C(*ALL) or subsystem name.

options.name: user
options.description: The user profile name to use as the job user filtering criteria. Valid values are user profile name, C(*USER) or C(*ALL).
